headline: SHCP withdraws fiscal stimulus on Magna gasoline and lowers diesel subsidy
summary: Mexico's finance ministry (SHCP) withdrew the IEPS fiscal stimulus on Magna gasoline and reduced the diesel subsidy. Diesel keeps a stimulus for the week of November 21 to 27.
why: Fuel tax incentives directly affect pump prices and inflation, which matter to Mexican fuel retailers, transport costs and the government's fiscal position.
original_headline: SHCP retira el estímulo fiscal a la gasolina Magna y baja el subsidio al diésel
